name: Audi Autonomous Driving Dataset (A2D2)
original_contributors: Audi Electronics Venture GmbH
notes: Download from the provider or its designated public cloud location. NoDerivatives restrictions require careful treatment of redistributed adaptations.

name: Argoverse 2
tasks: 3D detection | tracking | motion forecasting | scene flow
original_contributors: Benjamin Wilson et al.; Argo AI / Argoverse
notes: Follow the official user guide and cloud-download instructions; review component-specific licenses.

name: DALES
original_contributors: Nina Varney, Vijayan K. Asari, and Quinn Graehling
notes: Use the University of Dayton project source or the source named by the paper. Verify current access location and license before automated use.

name: K-Lane
original_contributors: Dong-Hee Paek, Seung-Hyun Kong, and Kevin Tirta Wijaya; KAIST
notes: Specialized benchmark for lane detection from LiDAR. Dataset and code conditions should be checked separately.

name: KITTI Vision Benchmark Suite
original_contributors: Andreas Geiger, Philip Lenz, Christoph Stiller, and Raquel Urtasun
notes: Download components separately from the official KITTI pages. Some downstream benchmarks add separate labels and terms.

name: KITTI-360
sensors: 3D LiDAR | stereo cameras | fisheye cameras | GPS/IMU
tasks: semantic segmentation | 3D reconstruction | localization | novel view synthesis
original_contributors: Yiyi Liao, Jun Xie, and Andreas Geiger
notes: Use the official download scripts/pages and review per-component terms.

name: Matterport3D
original_contributors: Angel Chang et al.; Matterport and academic collaborators
notes: Adjacent RGB-D/reconstruction resource. Access requires the official research-use agreement; do not use unofficial mirrors.

name: MIT Stata Center Data Set
original_contributors: MIT Marine Robotics Group / Luca Carlone et al.
notes: Use the official MIT project page and preserve experiment-specific documentation.

name: MulRan
original_contributors: Giseop Kim et al.; KAIST
notes: Use only the official Google Sites/download links and cite the MulRan publication.

name: NCLT Dataset
original_contributors: Nicholas Carlevaris-Bianco, Arash K. Ushani, and Ryan M. Eustice
notes: Use official per-session links and documentation. Treat absent or unclear license terms conservatively.

name: nuScenes
original_contributors: Holger Caesar et al.; Motional
notes: Create an official account, accept current terms, and use the official download portal/devkit.

name: Oxford RobotCar Dataset
original_contributors: Will Maddern, Geoffrey Pascoe, Chris Linegar, and Paul Newman
notes: Register through the official site; sequences are large and should be selected deliberately.

name: PandaSet
sensors: mechanical LiDAR | forward-facing LiDAR | cameras | GPS/IMU
original_contributors: Hesai and Scale AI
notes: Use the official portal and official devkit. Confirm current terms before commercial or derivative redistribution.

name: Paris-Lille-3D
original_contributors: Xavier Roynard, Jean-Emmanuel Deschaud, and François Goulette
notes: Use the official NPM3D page, review evaluation protocol, and cite the original paper.

name: RADISH Robotics Data Set Repository
original_contributors: Andrew Howard and Nicholas Roy; robotics community contributors
notes: Historical repository of robotics logs. Confirm attribution and any per-contribution conditions before reuse.

name: RELLIS-3D
original_contributors: Peng Jiang et al.; Texas A&M University
notes: Follow the official repository links for images, point clouds, labels, and calibration; inspect each hosted component’s terms.

name: Robot@Home
tasks: semantic mapping | object recognition | robot localization
original_contributors: José-Raúl Ruiz-Sarmiento, Cipriano Galindo, and Javier González-Jiménez; MAPIR, University of Málaga
notes: Mixed indoor robotics dataset. Follow official download and database tools; cite the dataset publication.

name: Stanford Large-Scale 3D Indoor Spaces (S3DIS)
original_contributors: Iro Armeni et al.; Stanford University
notes: Obtain access through the original provider procedure. Do not redistribute copies from third-party mirrors.

name: ScanNet
original_contributors: Angela Dai et al.; Stanford University
notes: Adjacent RGB-D resource, not LiDAR. Access requires the provider agreement, typically submitted with an institutional email.

name: ScanNet++
sensors: FARO laser scans | DSLR | iPhone RGB-D
tasks: semantic segmentation | novel view synthesis | 3D reconstruction
original_contributors: Chandan Yeshwanth, Yueh-Cheng Liu, Matthias Nießner, and Angela Dai
notes: Includes high-fidelity laser scans. Register and accept current official terms before downloading.

name: Semantic3D
original_contributors: Timo Hackel et al.; ETH Zurich
notes: Use the official benchmark portal and follow its registration, submission, and data-use requirements.

name: SemanticKITTI
tasks: semantic segmentation | panoptic segmentation | scene completion
original_contributors: Jens Behley, Martin Garbade, Andres Milioto, Jan Quenzel, Sven Behnke, C. Stachniss, and J. Gall
license_name: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 for annotations; KITTI terms also apply
notes: Users obtain KITTI odometry sensor data separately, then place SemanticKITTI labels into the matching sequence structure.

name: SemanticPOSS
original_contributors: Yue Wang et al.; Peking University
notes: The official site can be intermittent. Do not substitute an unofficial mirror without provider authorization.

name: SensatUrban
original_contributors: Qingyong Hu et al.; University of Oxford
notes: Adjacent resource: point clouds are photogrammetric, not LiDAR. It is included for transferable 3D learning comparisons and labeled accordingly.

name: Toronto-3D
original_contributors: Weikai Tan et al.; University of Waterloo
notes: Official repository provides project information and designated download links. Verify dataset and code licenses independently.

name: USGS 3D Elevation Program (3DEP)
tasks: terrain modeling | forestry | infrastructure | flood mapping
original_contributors: United States Geological Survey
license_name: U.S. government data; check item-level metadata
notes: Download through The National Map or official cloud access. Check item-level metadata because partner-supplied components can carry additional notices.

name: Waymo Open Dataset
original_contributors: Pei Sun et al.; Waymo LLC
notes: Dataset terms are separate from licenses for code in Waymo repositories. Do not describe the dataset as open-source.
